Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Networking preflight — private deploy session

Sam / Priya —

Thanks for taking the time earlier this week. As discussed, we'd like to run a focused architecture review that covers: VPC peering/topology, NAT/firewall rules, routing for air-gapped updates, and the on-prem appliance handoff. Goal is to surface any blockers before we commit to the deployment window in January.

Proposed agenda (30–45m):
- High-level network diagram review (your diagram + our overlay)
- Ports/IPs and egress controls required by Redwood agents
- Air-gap update story (pull-through registry approach)
- KMS/HSM integration touchpoints and audit logging
- Next steps & owners

Can you confirm who from infra should attend? We can do the session next week — I have availability: Tue 11/30 9–11am PT or Wed 12/1 1–4pm PT. If neither works, send preferred slots and we’ll try to accommodate.

Attachments: redwood-preflight-checklist.docx (checklist), gf-networking-diagram-v2.pdf (your latest diagram)

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0179

Alex —

Thanks, that agenda looks good. Priya will be the lead on our side for networking; she’s cc’d. We’ll also include our on-prem ops engineer (I’ll loop them once we lock the time).

From the diagram side, the attached PDF is accurate; one note — our proxy for outbound pulls sits behind a NAT and requires explicit allow rules.

For timing, 11/30 at 9am PT works for Priya and me. Can you send a calendar invite with a short dial-in and the preflight checklist?

—Sam

Thanks — invite sent for 2026-11-30 09:00 PT (30m) with Google Meet link. I attached a lightweight checklist (redwood-preflight-checklist.docx) that calls out the specific ports and hosts we will probe. Quick answers:
- Connectivity test: recommended if you can run from the on-prem appliance to our test endpoint (doc lists IPs). It only takes a few minutes and prevents time lost on the call.
- If you can’t run tests ahead of time, screenshots of appliance routing and firewall rules are sufficient.

One other operational ask: please confirm whether your airgap sync server requires mutual TLS to pull images. If so we’ll add notes to the checklist.

See you on the call — Alex

Attachment: redwood-preflight-checklist.docx
